item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Flag Decal
item_short_desc: Show your support of local Police and Law Enforcement Officials with the Rothco's Thin Blue Line Flag Decal. Great for cars, windows and more!
description: The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials; show your support with the Rothco's Thin Blue Line Flag Decal. The decal which measures 3" x 4 1/4" and features a gum back that can be applied to any clean, dry surface. Great for cars and home windows.
